query:
SELECT number AS "workstream!: i64" FROM copied_workstreams
               WHERE repository = ?1 AND number = ?2
               UNION
               SELECT workstream AS "workstream!: i64" FROM copied_issues
               WHERE repository = ?1 AND number = ?2
                 AND substr(repository_url, -length(?1) - 7) = '/repos/' || ?1 COLLATE NOCASE
